attributes.action: Call for a general election after Prime Minister resignation
attributes.additional_details:
For many, this lack of public input into who leads our nation is frustrating and disempowering. The significance of this issue hit close to home when I realized that changes in leadership have profoundly affected my day-to-day life and the future of our nation.

According to a survey by the Electoral Reform Society, 72% of voters believe that a general election should automatically follow the resignation of a Prime Minister.
attributes.background: When a Prime Minister resigns, the people of the United Kingdom are often left with a successor whom they had no direct say in selecting. This ongoing cycle undermines the democratic principles that our country holds dear, as it leaves the electorate without a voice during pivotal changes in Leaders
